Supported: ±0.30 K at 55°C, uniformity ±0.20 K at named plateau temperatures, 4–99°C range. Incomplete below-ambient footnote is retained as a gap.
Supported: ±0.2°C thermal accuracy has no specified test temperature in this bulletin. The 10-second timing condition belongs to uniformity; record correctly does not transfer it to accuracy.

manufacturerSpotChecks.section: Chip Types and Specifications rows; footnote **

manufacturerSpotChecks.result: Supported: fixed ring magnets, unpowered device, gripper-mediated labware movement; listed ambient temperature 20–25°C. No capture or assay performance inferred.
